title: Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival 2026: Nelly, Khalid, and Swae Lee headline two days of music
description: Shillong’s Cherry Blossom Festival returns November 20–21 at the Madan Kurkalang Sports Complex in Bhoirymbong, showcasing a cross-generational lineup that blends international stars like Nelly, Khalid, Swae Lee, Boys Like Girls, and Elliot James Reay with Indian singer Darshan Raval
